Fellow American,

**"While I am in Congress, no one will take Somalia's sea." - United States Congresswoman Ilhan Omar (MN-05)**
Yes, this is an actual quote from a Representative in the United States Congress. More importantly, this is an actual quote from my opponent, who I plan on sending back to Somalia on November 5th. She does not deserve to represent me or you any longer.

[**Help me buy her plane ticket with a donation to my campaign of any amount.**](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=19d252436c24447bba848a9513e5ba4a&_e=MbdUXyNFgSLzyI-dLq0o81XeKvdAWQ7lVgHWS0MMR_oc_sokdDhjfDnBKZPnnuKvFQvwwsbAjjK7ExwUmMu0NUmJuUH_zrYd_OCKhSd1APGBfHR3IWe1wtymqkJ_OfLBg89FOyjys-MHtBt0wSZTcuvstLDzPuHS2URwAXK6rPISUEXDIv9qmfxUll22J7vhhLryQi7Dvv3d7JlrySapsbJYTjoU_On46M8s5Zy1p1khrYG_lz-yi6ZnpkdvINx7I4hVLzucfyeK0tjltq77LPKqVnqTt5-1a0DE0xIWPAgluIDu_qG2OjVAiHwy9Sx2BxEe7-awBh2S5XA3f_ygDXGhfuGHDyaaUTnI_-R4a8adNE4MSk-xG1vQfaaQaG9VKmxeaO_NfIglVNrWMt-ElxLHuQZsS74Nz6aUJixvdPjLja0Q4UEAqNtE7aqysqT4)

Ilhan Omar has made it clear time and time again that her allegiance lies with Somalia, Hamas, and other American-hating groups. Meanwhile, she disgraces the halls of Congress in Washington, D.C., every day by aligning herself with the Squad and the most Radical factions of the Radical Left.

**I've had enough, and so have the people of Minnesota-05. It's time to expel her from Congress, and that starts with winning this election on November 5.**

But Ilhan Omar has the backing of the Squad and the Deep State Democrats' millions of dollars. The only way we can win is with a strong, nationwide grassroots Conservative effort.

**That's why I'm setting a goal to collect just 50 donations by midnight tonight. No donation is too small (or large) to make a difference in this race.**
[**I'm humbly asking you to send my campaign a donation to help me hit my midnight donor goal.**](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=19d252436c24447bba848a9513e5ba4a&_e=MbdUXyNFgSLzyI-dLq0o81XeKvdAWQ7lVgHWS0MMR_oc_sokdDhjfDnBKZPnnuKvFQvwwsbAjjK7ExwUmMu0NUmJuUH_zrYd_OCKhSd1APGBfHR3IWe1wtymqkJ_OfLBg89FOyjys-MHtBt0wSZTcuvstLDzPuHS2URwAXK6rPISUEXDIv9qmfxUll22J7vhhLryQi7Dvv3d7JlrySapsbJYTjoU_On46M8s5Zy1p1khrYG_lz-yi6ZnpkdvINx7I4hVLzucfyeK0tjltq77LDY5BPY8BgtjrdbvHqJg8n7RUsL_1hd7rypy91Zdi-7WmalDwo_fyRae4UvBAKYP1O8w1uw5Qf7TwJ4IRyXGamVM4Q4qmNbcZnSbGLpoWXoCBBxoJKjlgIYHDWkpNpJFYeNybcSVXZy5dwpaGqASJCETW_A-XNK64hkohgBH2-XU)

If Ilhan Omar wants to protect Somalia's sea rather than America's border, I'd be more than happy to fund her plane ticket back to Somalia after I beat her in November. “Christians, get out and vote!” yelled Trump . “Just this time. You won’t have to do it anymore. Four more years. You know what? It’ll be fixed! It’ll be fine! You won’t have to vote anymore, my beautiful Christians. I love you, Christians!” He added , “You gotta get out and vote. In four years, you don’t have to vote again. We’ll have it fixed so good, you’re not gonna have to vote .”
That's Donald Trump in his own words over the weekend, Team. His blatant pandering to religious voters aside, the implications of his words are terrifying.
We can't afford to ignore this, we have to take him at his word. Remember, this is a man who called for terminating the Constitution after he wouldn't accept that he lost the 2020 election and urged supporters to go confront Congress. # [Kamala and Me](https://public-api.wordpress.com/bar/?stat=groovemails-events&bin=wpcom_email_click&redirect_to=http%3A%2F%2Fbethfarnhamforcongress.com%2F2024%2F08%2F03%2Fkamala-and-me%2F&sr=0&signature=44c707b764f84fde1af21a5b9d9042ae&blog_id=213069660&user=248418217&_&_z=z)
| | By **Elizabeth Farnham** on August 3, 2024
---|---
_(Originally published by The Gettysburg Connection on July 31, 2024 under the title, "Why I Support Kamala Harris."_)
With a grace and humility that convicted felon Donald Trump has never known, President Biden ended his campaign to be re-elected, then endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris.
Vice President Harris brings not only a fresh energy to the top of the Democratic ticket, she brings her whip-smart intellect as a former prosecutor, her electability as a former U.S. senator, and a continuation of the successful Biden administration. I can’t think of anyone I would rather see defeat convicted felon Trump than this history-making woman of color. Not only did she break the glass ceiling of elected offices held by women in the USA, she broke the 24-hour donation record for ActBlue after the announcement of her candidacy for President of the United States of America. The lift the Democratic party has experienced in the aftermath of her announcement is translating into polls that increasingly favor her against Trump.
I absolutely support and endorse Vice President Kamala Harris for President of the United States, not only for the reasons mentioned above, but because our platforms are well-aligned. Fighting for Democracy, Reproductive Freedom, Gun Safety, Public Education, Universal Healthcare, and Immigration Reform, we tackle the issues that are most important to our quality of life in the United States. While she counters Trump who said this past Friday, “You won’t even need to vote” threatening our sacred right to vote again, I continue to challenge Representative John Joyce on his abhorrent refusal to certify our valid electoral votes from Pennsylvania in the wee hours of January 7th, 2021, on the backend of Trump’s violent insurrection. Representative Joyce is “proud” to be endorsed by that convicted felon and continues to believe his lies of election fraud. Recently, Representative Joyce approved the Supreme Court’s disastrous decision to grant convicted felon Trump immunity for his illegal actions as President of the United States. The stakes to preserve our precious Democracy have never been higher, yet I trust Vice President Kamala Harris to win the election and sign into federal law more protections for our voting rights so that we never come this close to losing them again.
In the aftermath of the Dobbs decision which overturned the Supreme Court’s Roe v. Wade decision, Trump claimed, “I did that!” and Representative Joyce co-sponsored the egregiously unscientific Life at Conception Act. Mercifully, this terrible bill which asserted fetal personhood did not pass the House of Representatives, but Republicans have recently circled back to implementing this awful idea through their Project 2025 plan. Representative Joyce has not condemned Project 2025 and continues to have a 100% favorable rating from the National Right to Life Committee whose position against safe and legal abortion is so extreme it wouldn’t condone it for a raped ten year old in 2022. Reproductive Freedom not only includes access to safe and legal abortion, but also birth control, In Vitro Fertilization, gender-affirming care, and/or partnering with consenting adults of any gender. Vice President Kamala Harris has pledged to “restore Reproductive Freedom” and her campaign recognizes that “Project 2025 will still be on the ballot” even though the original director of it stepped down.
Only when we can create the families we choose can we truly be free.
I do however believe in the Right to Life...of our living breathing children whose leading cause of death in Pennsylvania and the United States of America is Gun Violence. I advocate safe storage of firearms, reporting of lost or stolen guns, universal background checks for all gun sales, and Extreme Risk Protection Orders or Red Flag Laws for those who present a risk of harm to themselves or others. Executive director of Moms Demand Action, Angela Ferrell-Zabala stated, “Throughout her career, Vice President Harris has shaped gun safety policy to protect survivors, invest in communities, and get firearms out of the hands of people who shouldn’t have them. Our movement of 11 million is well-prepared to meet this historic moment and elect Vice President Harris as our next president.” In June, I received recognition as a Candidate of Distinction from Moms Demand Action. John Feinblatt, president of Everytown for Gun Safety, stated,“Vice President Kamala Harris has helped lead the strongest gun safety administration in American history, with accomplishments that include breaking the 30-year logjam on federal gun safety legislation and taking historic executive actions to combat gun trafficking and ghost guns.”
Vice President Harris has soundly criticized Project 2025 for its backward policies on Public Education, like dismantling the federal Department of Education, ending student loan forgiveness for public sector workers like teachers, and getting rid of Head Start which provides Early Education to 800,000 low-income families around the country. Like me, Vice President Harris recognizes herself as a product of public education and understands the benefits it provides for society as a whole.
While Project 2025 asserts that the Department of Health and Human Services should be “Biblically-based,” Vice President Harris has an agenda, just like the Revolutionary Founders of this country, that separates Church from State. “We can expect her to try to build on the Biden legacy of expanding coverage,” said Sabrina Corlette, a health policy expert and research professor at Georgetown University. “And she’s going to have to do something to bring down costs.” “Corlette predicted Harris would look to [protect the Affordable Care Act ](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.wordpress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=cc97f8a6b5ee38448e77e48f61bae452a1deaebf4278a207260570815948bb11&blog_id=213069660&post_id=658&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=bebda17df93b64c129dc48271535a776&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmJjbmV3cy5jb20vaGVhbHRoL2hlYWx0aC1jYXJlLzIwMjQtcHJlc2lkZW50aWFsLWVsZWN0aW9uLW1heS10aHJlYXRlbi1oZWFsdGgtY292ZXJhZ2UtbWlsbGlvbnMtcmNuYTEzOTEwOQ=)and extend the enhanced subsidies designed to lower costs, which are set to expire at the end of 2025. She would also be likely to work with Congress to try to extend Medicaid coverage in the 10 states that haven’t expanded it under the Affordable Care Act. And she could carry on Biden’s attempts to expand Medicare to cover dental, vision and hearing benefits for seniors.” [Harris to Expand Affordable Care Act](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.wordpress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=80f2ee972c1ff517449d4279dcddf9749f7eb163135306dc3a529b80b8a629de&blog_id=213069660&post_id=658&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=d36822067b5401e9c23fd75e2feec7d1&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmJjbmV3cy5jb20vcG9saXRpY3MvMjAyMC1lbGVjdGlvbi9rYW1hbGEtaGFycmlzLXByZXNpZGVuY3ktbWVhbi11cy1oZWFsdGgtY2FyZS1hYm9ydGlvbi1yY25hMTYzMTI0). Vice President Harris and I agree that the right to healthcare should never depend on one’s economic, marital, or employment status, gender, age, sex, color, race, creed, ethnicity, country of origin, nor their religion.
As a child of immigrants, Vice President Harris has a full understanding of what immigration does for America - creating American families and workers, for example. Like me, she recognizes that clear paths to citizenship are most needed and beneficial to our country. “We need the tools in order to have more resources at the border, to have more resources in the states and cities that are supporting migrants, and I believe we need a pathway to citizenship...All of that is part of what we need to do for comprehensive immigration reform. Kamala Harris will work with Congress and get that done” - Senator Elizabeth Warren.
As a high tide lifts all boats, I believe that Vice President Harris will not only win the election, but boost all down ballot Democratic candidates, including me. Please vote for her, me, and other Democratic candidates on November 5th.
Together, we CHOOSE DEMOCRACY

With a grace and humility that convicted felon Donald Trump has never known, President Biden ended his campaign to be re-elected, the... | or | | | or ---|---|--- | | By Elizabeth Farnham on August 3, 2024 ---|--- (Originally published by The Gettysburg Connection on July 31, 2024 under the title, "Why I Support Kamala Harris.") With a grace and humility that convicted felon Donald Trump has never known, President Biden ended his campaign to be re-elected, then endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris. Vice President Harris brings not only a fresh energy to the top of the Democratic ticket, she brings her whip-smart intellect as a former prosecutor, her electability as a former U.S. senator, and a continuation of the successful Biden administration. I can’t think of anyone I would rather see defeat convicted felon Trump than this history-making woman of color. Not only did she break the glass ceiling of elected offices held by women in the USA, she broke the 24-hour donation record for ActBlue after the announcement of her candidacy for President of the United States of America. The lift the Democratic party has experienced in the aftermath of her announcement is translating into polls that increasingly favor her against Trump. I absolutely support and endorse Vice President Kamala Harris for President of the United States, not only for the reasons mentioned above, but because our platforms are well-aligned. Fighting for Democracy, Reproductive Freedom, Gun Safety, Public Education, Universal Healthcare, and Immigration Reform, we tackle the issues that are most important to our quality of life in the United States. While she counters Trump who said this past Friday, “You won’t even need to vote” threatening our sacred right to vote again, I continue to challenge Representative John Joyce on his abhorrent refusal to certify our valid electoral votes from Pennsylvania in the wee hours of January 7th, 2021, on the backend of Trump’s violent insurrection. Representative Joyce is “proud” to be endorsed by that convicted felon and continues to believe his lies of election fraud. Recently, Representative Joyce approved the Supreme Court’s disastrous decision to grant convicted felon Trump immunity for his illegal actions as President of the United States. The stakes to preserve our precious Democracy have never been higher, yet I trust Vice President Kamala Harris to win the election and sign into federal law more protections for our voting rights so that we never come this close to losing them again. In the aftermath of the Dobbs decision which overturned the Supreme Court’s Roe v. Wade decision, Trump claimed, “I did that!” and Representative Joyce co-sponsored the egregiously unscientific Life at Conception Act. Mercifully, this terrible bill which asserted fetal personhood did not pass the House of Representatives, but Republicans have recently circled back to implementing this awful idea through their Project 2025 plan. Representative Joyce has not condemned Project 2025 and continues to have a 100% favorable rating from the National Right to Life Committee whose position against safe and legal abortion is so extreme it wouldn’t condone it for a raped ten year old in 2022. Reproductive Freedom not only includes access to safe and legal abortion, but also birth control, In Vitro Fertilization, gender-affirming care, and/or partnering with consenting adults of any gender. Vice President Kamala Harris has pledged to “restore Reproductive Freedom” and her campaign recognizes that “Project 2025 will still be on the ballot” even though the original director of it stepped down. Only when we can create the families we choose can we truly be free. I do however believe in the Right to Life...of our living breathing children whose leading cause of death in Pennsylvania and the United States of America is Gun Violence. I advocate safe storage of firearms, reporting of lost or stolen guns, universal background checks for all gun sales, and Extreme Risk Protection Orders or Red Flag Laws for those who present a risk of harm to themselves or others. Executive director of Moms Demand Action, Angela Ferrell-Zabala stated, “Throughout her career, Vice President Harris has shaped gun safety policy to protect survivors, invest in communities, and get firearms out of the hands of people who shouldn’t have them. Our movement of 11 million is well-prepared to meet this historic moment and elect Vice President Harris as our next president.” In June, I received recognition as a Candidate of Distinction from Moms Demand Action. John Feinblatt, president of Everytown for Gun Safety, stated,“Vice President Kamala Harris has helped lead the strongest gun safety administration in American history, with accomplishments that include breaking the 30-year logjam on federal gun safety legislation and taking historic executive actions to combat gun trafficking and ghost guns.” Vice President Harris has soundly criticized Project 2025 for its backward policies on Public Education, like dismantling the federal Department of Education, ending student loan forgiveness for public sector workers like teachers, and getting rid of Head Start which provides Early Education to 800,000 low-income families around the country. Like me, Vice President Harris recognizes herself as a product of public education and understands the benefits it provides for society as a whole. While Project 2025 asserts that the Department of Health and Human Services should be “Biblically-based,” Vice President Harris has an agenda, just like the Revolutionary Founders of this country, that separates Church from State. “We can expect her to try to build on the Biden legacy of expanding coverage,” said Sabrina Corlette, a health policy expert and research professor at Georgetown University. “And she’s going to have to do something to bring down costs.” “Corlette predicted Harris would look to extend the enhanced subsidies designed to lower costs, which are set to expire at the end of 2025. She would also be likely to work with Congress to try to extend Medicaid coverage in the 10 states that haven’t expanded it under the Affordable Care Act. And she could carry on Biden’s attempts to expand Medicare to cover dental, vision and hearing benefits for seniors.” . Vice President Harris and I agree that the right to healthcare should never depend on one’s economic, marital, or employment status, gender, age, sex, color, race, creed, ethnicity, country of origin, nor their religion. As a child of immigrants, Vice President Harris has a full understanding of what immigration does for America - creating American families and workers, for example. Like me, she recognizes that clear paths to citizenship are most needed and beneficial to our country. “We need the tools in order to have more resources at the border, to have more resources in the states and cities that are supporting migrants, and I believe we need a pathway to citizenship...All of that is part of what we need to do for comprehensive immigration reform. Kamala Harris will work with Congress and get that done” - Senator Elizabeth Warren. As a high tide lifts all boats, I believe that Vice President Harris will not only win the election, but boost all down ballot Democratic candidates, including me. Please vote for her, me, and other Democratic candidates on November 5th. body:
In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?
| | | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zo6rk80eu2oadalajqhukmnnj15vei4pi91kippg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cthmaor6cth2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zcafcr3kn9hjbulg7hput2sacdph702vng8icd28_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cthmaor6cth2bs)

This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z9cfue9bd14l7bq4kb1mtkl92sa9fvmtjc95570g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cthmaor6cth2bs)

Your generosity enables _Pathway to Victory_ to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

## List: Salaries Needed to Feel Rich
What salary do you need to feel like you're rich? According to [Bankrate's 2024 Financial Freedom survey](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQgOGn0W4dQDy4giKN3aVN6aywHiQIDnI6vn0mSZv-L775Px7TA0MM6fmOK5m65AltDQdNGiQIOcnWmYVIUN-S4UoIpTRXovXmNoh56K1ETcrye8-ldcNwt5ZQoeSqDUYwIZlmkjPGpOpuXDmt77PuBzkrdI1k5ELNpfvMIVVPS7zyQaWzeW2j8bVue9O_NWJsxHieZ_cVth_qX9GIcaOy54QRlpAwWWrE6PMJ68t6WHOiC1yGK78gETmoGWaCEqyH_VUOuqDQQRh3OAlj9fDMGPe2GLedIcaw31Qj2XPFEH9F9d89hxHfAQAA___aJGog), the average American would say $520K a year, with slight variances between different age groups. Gen Z (ages 18-27) required the least amount to feel rich at $461K a year, while Gen X (ages 44-59) required the most at $556K. The study also found that most Americans have a different definition for feeling rich than for achieving "financial success," the latter having more to do with living comfortably day-to-day with money left over for savings.

body:

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-RPBbQcxOXg)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and stop fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-_WqpMwARrM6-tjk_qg)**** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._pUpdIWM2z3NFTb-J1w)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

subject: Empower your child with timeless biblical values
body:
In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?
| | | [](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkL2K3DAURp9G7mT0t5ZTuFgYptsQwkJKcVe6tkWsH6TrWfL2wSHTb_sdOHC-X2_uDeIR8_YdEi7UyLXuMrhKD46plk9s_E85m1NCGS5mLozTQ1iMVUFPAy7SKmWtFlYO-wKreFnVFFZtzbdVC6MCeANWvggE8GqIy-URszBSGCvUKI2EeQLv5fwR1OyZEXBgoz7Sjg3r-XFED5kQ0uhLGo5lJ6qd6Vem7kzdO_qz4VjpMZa2MXWnHbkU3JeUIIeEmTpfS-O_Y-h8w4ytnJ1vcSUumb6flFwvZ_PI9K220it6inljarpQwhDPxPQNE8Tj_-ghVYhbZvpGOzop3CV_wpIJMzF9-_HK33--82fw0JZQP-NxxD5ZZsR2Gf810Zd_fyzqbwAAAP__fl-OHw)
---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkL2K3DAURp9G7mT0t5ZTuFgYptsQwkJKcVe6tkWsH6TrWfL2wSHTb_sdOHC-X2_uDeIR8_YdEi7UyLXuMrhKD46plk9s_E85m1NCGS5mLozTQ1iMVUFPAy7SKmWtFlYO-wKreFnVFFZtzbdVC6MCeANWvggE8GqIy-URszBSGCvUKI2EeQLv5fwR1OyZEXBgoz7Sjg3r-XFED5kQ0uhLGo5lJ6qd6Vem7kzdO_qz4VjpMZa2MXWnHbkU3JeUIIeEmTpfS-O_Y-h8w4ytnJ1vcSUumb6flFwvZ_PI9K220it6inljarpQwhDPxPQNE8Tj_-ghVYhbZvpGOzop3CV_wpIJMzF9-_HK33--82fw0JZQP-NxxD5ZZsR2Gf810Zd_fyzqbwAAAP__fl-OHw)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](https://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkL2K3DAURp9G7mT0t5ZTuFgYptsQwkJKcVe6tkWsH6TrWfL2wSHTb_sdOHC-X2_uDeIR8_YdEi7UyLXuMrhKD46plk9s_E85m1NCGS5mLozTQ1iMVUFPAy7SKmWtFlYO-wKreFnVFFZtzbdVC6MCeANWvggE8GqIy-URszBSGCvUKI2EeQLv5fwR1OyZEXBgoz7Sjg3r-XFED5kQ0uhLGo5lJ6qd6Vem7kzdO_qz4VjpMZa2MXWnHbkU3JeUIIeEmTpfS-O_Y-h8w4ytnJ1vcSUumb6flFwvZ_PI9K220it6inljarpQwhDPxPQNE8Tj_-ghVYhbZvpGOzop3CV_wpIJMzF9-_HK33--82fw0JZQP-NxxD5ZZsR2Gf810Zd_fyzqbwAAAP__fl-OHw)

body:
In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?
| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=be24453683fb450497385eb50763246d&_e=T7gXTYvqWeRvbaDZC_rRKAZp18AMLE7nAVIaTiDZndyXX3oIJ7VAt8CjLKqBhT6m7sIOjw4ANf5HcZTTVX4_nivuYsn14EzjJL2Bq_i_29KYsI1CGyrFd4eclAU7OSXnJbsL_fyyuaVnwzqkxIpzQFOWvi_hXALSMIZ6FsQUiHiOVdrp20AO205uJw2y9voSG10CTroJJkXB9dCktICM2bnJF4WqTzYVXs749ax4VSzxi1s4sPbwIiVAgR11BaK7BmCdKXdzuTi57GqcqZRvcCimLy8eSHO-wgXN2usuv8xXqHYpE-79HtbN7nbHCNvZdQwRh-4MSTjU9qEfbg6GIM1BcSuPd4-hf3K_yKmd8PDnJpi1RU8xWPr8ssKtxWJG)
---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.

This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

subject: Empower your child with timeless biblical values
body:
In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=590096a4634f417f9fe590ab1afaa5c6&_e=6E_KRsWp42VxmG8A3I25lBpbyi8ewr7YrFiOHq8mYDf-T93gTpQe7teiTtlFv8JlxEMoCDvtszyrA0ro_zPlD_YNB4y2PsOHmJKZC7y7manDu650SzreD-jBew--JAYMs1P6zWu8p4ZSjgS5d0gyeHuTn2LS-bXVkj3wVl8RVo7SzvaLxHXRVNCcGSzI7lyCsxzRRYs6kvaE8naCyYY6turJSk6NP4WPVbHxYDB-dzyDznKdKEFT6AJ11TVXMy02_IIi7htRw0erNBqkjUGFIhSL0ADfR7h9Lt9X4GJnUw3q1UR1G1_-uobqtmqZd01qF544Gu7Bf3nL81Zw8vUYl5UNhaMHeVICnaMNe4f6n5XnGIns2uV68ZcKMFwf-kK9)
---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=590096a4634f417f9fe590ab1afaa5c6&_e=6E_KRsWp42VxmG8A3I25lBpbyi8ewr7YrFiOHq8mYDf-T93gTpQe7teiTtlFv8JlxEMoCDvtszyrA0ro_zPlD_YNB4y2PsOHmJKZC7y7manDu650SzreD-jBew--JAYMs1P6zWu8p4ZSjgS5d0gyeHuTn2LS-bXVkj3wVl8RVo7SzvaLxHXRVNCcGSzI7lyCsxzRRYs6kvaE8naCyYY6turJSk6NP4WPVbHxYDB-dzxS3cGnJlE7eRXnoFzff-J7LvjoVZVe9V5826NSlgdgWU9PBRseAxzT5NP0G7dOpmgaMICjlvbxIU0I2Vdli24nh1V-YHP2p7lt1Bq0s5_pAcDhuhO1pkGF2w0wFp-QnvTcx1XQ0z2oNIX56KXRhAY4)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=590096a4634f417f9fe590ab1afaa5c6&_e=6E_KRsWp42VxmG8A3I25lBpbyi8ewr7YrFiOHq8mYDf-T93gTpQe7teiTtlFv8JlxEMoCDvtszyrA0ro_zPlD_YNB4y2PsOHmJKZC7y7manDu650SzreD-jBew--JAYMs1P6zWu8p4ZSjgS5d0gyeHuTn2LS-bXVkj3wVl8RVo7SzvaLxHXRVNCcGSzI7lyCsxzRRYs6kvaE8naCyYY6turJSk6NP4WPVbHxYDB-dzyFEdomzOiS3F46LhnRAfPU0A9TQgdgLTM8INDMjU_hFpnjCyXEMwVSvnJ5pFJHEKwJ5skRtb8B7OMv896g21PSwQTtygGuEOeN5WHseeszFCLve1NwR2282HVoTAzZZxQRtx9CO5xL23DFyrk3ZU-J)

Your generosity enables _Pathway to Victory_ to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

clean_body: In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return? | | | Hello Friend, Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living. In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace. | | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, The 10 Commandments for Kids book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies. | | | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities. I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ. For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: Your generosity enables Pathway to Victory to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ. Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ. Dear Friend, Populism is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think about American politics as being divided between the Left and the Right, the reality is much different.

| | Dear Friend,Populism is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think about American politics as being divided between the Left and the Right, the reality is much different. What we've really been seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat and Republican establishment.
---
| [](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---
| | And believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back to Roman times.

That's why I'm sending you this email today.

I want to make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks: **[Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson](http://trk.secureandprosper._fYlTEMxapjcO55PmiPDA)**.

Hanson is a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think you'll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important eBook, you'll learn more about:
* What we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that rebel against both the establishment--and each other.
* The important parallels between these ancient movements and their modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative populism.
* What lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our culture.

You can get your free copy of Dueling Populisms using this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/dueling-populisms-signup/](http://trk.secureandprosper.-mzA9YRg)**.

And please feel free to share this with your family and friends. It's important that we recall the voices of experience and apply them to contemporary conflicts and challenges.

You can use this link to get access to your free eBook right now.
Thanks,Greg Greg Stamps | Online DevelopmentHoover Institution | Stanford University

Stop the Gender Radicals
| Peter, I’m Riley Gaines. You may have heard my name in the news. I’m an All-American swimmer -- but I’m better known for my role in the fight to save women’s sports.
Women and girls have a right to compete fairly, and to private locker rooms. I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men. **Just this year, a female golfer lost her spot in the U.S. Women’s Open qualifier at Bradenton to a man, James “Hailey” Davidson.** Then, USA Today _took down_ a brilliant op-ed by Republican Senator John Kennedy. In the op-ed, he demanded to know if “inclusion” should be prioritized over fairness and safety when it comes to sports. But Peter, I won’t be censored! Instead, I seek to build a community of thousands of sensible Americans who know the difference between a man and a woman. I am sure you didn't wake up on this lovely Sunday morning, spring out of bed and scream, "Today is the day I am going to donate to Elissa Slotkin to hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats!"
But I am emailing in the hope that you will consider contributing today anyway. Here’s why:
Michigan's primary is in two days.
This is the date that's been circled on our calendars since we launched last year. And it means we have 90 days left to sprint to the general election.

Michigan is going to be one of the closest, most competitive and expensive Senate races in the country this year. Recent polling shows a dead-heat in both the Senate and the Presidential races, which means we have two competitive elections to win.
Donations a month or two from now – when we’re in the home stretch of the sprint – are important. But to be frank, donations now, as we recently entered the 90 day window for the general election, are even more important. subject: Delco spends 11x more on lawyers than in 2019
body:

---
| | | Good morning and welcome to _Broad + Liberty_ 's Weekly Reads.

[Subscribe to our daily email list](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8e6438b2d7&e=b7b3eddce2) and get the best of _Broad + Liberty_ delivered straight to your inbox.

### **1.[Delaware County’s spending on third-party attorneys now over $4.5 million](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9a1e9fffd5&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Todd Shepherd_
Delaware County spent $4.5 million in 2023 to hire the help of third-party attorneys, continuing a dizzying years-long rise in that category, according to a Broad + Liberty analysis of documents obtained by a Right to Know request. The $4.5 million figure is eleven times more than what the county spent on outside counsel in 2019, the last year Republicans were in control of the county council. For a simple year-over-year comparison, it’s a 30 percent increase over what the council spent in 2022. **Why It Matters.** The increase in spending is just one of the contributing factors that led to council’s decision to raise taxes in 2023 by five percent, and at least one council member is already signaling that a[ “sizable” tax increase](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f081d4a885&e=b7b3eddce2) is likely for the next year. The legal spending also surprises when compared to the county’s neighbors. For example, Delco’s third-party attorney spending in 2023 is just a few thousand dollars away from the same category of spending by Bucks County across all four years of 2020-2023. **Quotable. **Delaware County GOP Chairwoman Meaghan Wagner blasted the latest numbers: “As a practicing attorney, former prosecutor, and local elected official who has intimate knowledge of the inner workings of both county government and political parties, these numbers are offensive. It’s just another example of this administration’s total incompetence which comes at the expense of Delaware County taxpayers.” **[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=ef5233fccf&e=b7b3eddce2)**
---
|
---
|
### **2.[Josh Shapiro — A wolf in sheep’s clothing](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c6b2596d61&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Beth Ann Rosica_
"Throughout his career, Josh has taken on the status quo, brought people together, and _fought to keep Pennsylvanians from getting screwed_ — and that’s exactly what he’ll do as Governor.” That statement was part of his campaign in 2022 when he was running for Governor of Pennsylvania. A month before the election, I[ questioned](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5efc442258&e=b7b3eddce2) whether Shapiro would actually fight for Pennsylvanians because if past performance is indicative of future behaviors, it did not seem likely. Before being elected as Governor, Shapiro served as the Attorney General for the commonwealth. As Attorney General, he supported former Governor Tom Wolf’s Covid-19 mandates and lockdowns. Shapiro never pushed back on the extended school and business closures or mask and vaccine mandates. And then he did a complete 180 and[ claimed](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=cb1cde4cf7&e=b7b3eddce2) the actions were not necessary. Whether you like his choice of words or not, Shapiro did not fight to keep Pennsylvanians from being screwed as Attorney General and he certainly has not fought as Governor. **Why It Matters.** While Shapiro talks about working across the aisle, getting things done, and preventing people from getting screwed, it is only that: talk. Rather than bringing people together, he has angered both sides. His progressive base and the teachers’ union are unhappy with his verbal support of school choice. He has also alienated the moderates and conservatives who hoped and possibly believed he would do the right thing for students in failing schools. The bottom line is Shapiro has failed everyone and does not deserve consideration for the Vice President seat. He may present as polished and politically savvy, but Shapiro is nothing more than a wolf in sheep’s clothing. **[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c742574140&e=b7b3eddce2)**

# **5\. What we're reading**
The Democrats are getting back into segregation — but they promise it’s for a good reason this time. That’s the impression one gets reading [articles like this one in the _Free Press_](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=009fb0bdb0&e=b7b3eddce2) about the “White Dudes for Kamala” Zoom meetings, and others like it. Reporter River Page sees through the double standard. “Imagine if Republicans put on a celebrity-studded event called “White Dudes for Trump” that raised $4 million. Imagine the endless op-eds. Consider the B-roll that outlets like NPR or MSNBC might use: Klan rallies, January 6, clips from The Handmaid’s Tale, perhaps.”

And they call Trump weird?

By Todd Shepherd Delaware County spent $4.5 million in 2023 to hire the help of third-party attorneys, continuing a dizzying years-long rise in that category, according to a Broad + Liberty analysis of documents obtained by a Right to Know request. The $4.5 million figure is eleven times more than what the county spent on outside counsel in 2019, the last year Republicans were in control of the county council. For a simple year-over-year comparison, it’s a 30 percent increase over what the council spent in 2022. Why It Matters. The increase in spending is just one of the contributing factors that led to council’s decision to raise taxes in 2023 by five percent, and at least one council member is already signaling that a is likely for the next year. The legal spending also surprises when compared to the county’s neighbors. For example, Delco’s third-party attorney spending in 2023 is just a few thousand dollars away from the same category of spending by Bucks County across all four years of 2020-2023. Quotable. Delaware County GOP Chairwoman Meaghan Wagner blasted the latest numbers: “As a practicing attorney, former prosecutor, and local elected official who has intimate knowledge of the inner workings of both county government and political parties, these numbers are offensive. It’s just another example of this administration’s total incompetence which comes at the expense of Delaware County taxpayers.” | | 2. By Beth Ann Rosica "Throughout his career, Josh has taken on the status quo, brought people together, and fought to keep Pennsylvanians from getting screwed — and that’s exactly what he’ll do as Governor.” That statement was part of his campaign in 2022 when he was running for Governor of Pennsylvania. A month before the election, I whether Shapiro would actually fight for Pennsylvanians because if past performance is indicative of future behaviors, it did not seem likely. Before being elected as Governor, Shapiro served as the Attorney General for the commonwealth. As Attorney General, he supported former Governor Tom Wolf’s Covid-19 mandates and lockdowns. Shapiro never pushed back on the extended school and business closures or mask and vaccine mandates. And then he did a complete 180 and the actions were not necessary. Whether you like his choice of words or not, Shapiro did not fight to keep Pennsylvanians from being screwed as Attorney General and he certainly has not fought as Governor. Why It Matters. While Shapiro talks about working across the aisle, getting things done, and preventing people from getting screwed, it is only that: talk. Rather than bringing people together, he has angered both sides. His progressive base and the teachers’ union are unhappy with his verbal support of school choice. He has also alienated the moderates and conservatives who hoped and possibly believed he would do the right thing for students in failing schools. The bottom line is Shapiro has failed everyone and does not deserve consideration for the Vice President seat. body:

| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T468e4441-50a9-40a4-856c-04533f724705/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

|
---
| | | | | Peter, It’s Alexander Vindman, reaching out to you with a personal request. [Can you split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and my twin brother Eugene’s campaign for Congress today? I ask because I know I can count on you. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T911a5725-530a-47cd-921e-e3478b0ed9f0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) You probably know this already, but Eugene and I value integrity and honesty above all else. These principles guided us throughout our decades of military service. It's what compelled us to blow the whistle on Donald Trump's attempt to extort our allies in Ukraine when we overheard a concerning phone call. And now, it's what motivated Eugene to run for Congress. Eugene is running for Congress to uphold those same values and continue his fight to defend our democracy and the Constitution we both vowed to protect. And more than that, he will fight to restore and expand the fundamental rights right-wing forces have worked so hard to take away: the right to reproductive freedom, the right to vote, the right for us and our kids to live without fear of gun violence. But he can't win these fights alone. I am with him – nothing is more important to me right now. But we need you with us, standing by our side, because Trump and his allies will do whatever they can to keep him out of Washington. [So, Peter, can I count on you to split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and my brother Eugene Vindman's campaign for Congress in Virginia? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T70dfa207-d282-47c9-aaef-0fe0a8807e3e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| We're at a crucial point in Eugene’s campaign and he needs all of us to rally behind him, just like he stood firm when facing off against Trump. Thank you in advance for your donation. Any help you can lend to our campaign today is greatly appreciated. — Alexander Vindman, Lt. Col. (Retired)

body:

Peter, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=30b832c453d749d3afca9a077c68bf98&_e=gv9hCgekOoZb-NX42V2smnMLfx3IeGVGZtgMhd3ltvh50Cqwia-loHacpkwpC2z92Q_qPjIttoEQKOO2xlXPXiv-QSBR3JJD3Wi50yBISN0_eDKvjCv9Ur094eXi4yf1Qu9tzT5n8AmTJS9pTzWY372Z2tgHwMvMFaWVJvPLtyqePOV9LIkfSEOtTB5K-Jwp-PIb2BOKxJ54efo8bWWXMHzjDboO68Wf7B5UkKNUqb7EEbWh87szfB2tDphl9O1vQjuKazDzQcLsfJ7hfH2W6w%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=30b832c453d749d3afca9a077c68bf98&_e=gv9hCgekOoZb-NX42V2smnMLfx3IeGVGZtgMhd3ltvh50Cqwia-loHacpkwpC2z92Q_qPjIttoEQKOO2xlXPXiv-QSBR3JJD3Wi50yBISN0_eDKvjCv9Ur094eXi4yf1J0lFWhpCyDLmB5wocc-rUl9J71LPcZv3PCxjGteZFNSGuN5nDUKuNuF5mj6HJNkqntaian8pv77sYPc9HhKko9768x0UsnsumR91aVPhkjvGFYvR8u1RPvF-Q7560fv9765qzQVkHE7dAPW8-ioHVw%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---

They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us. Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. I hope you'll consider joining the fight by But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs. Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon CEO, The Babylon Bee | Copyright © 2024 Babylon Bee, All rights reserved. playing dominoes with my mom
| | |
---
Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90188133/489696600/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1647-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWJkN2VlNTYtNjY1Mi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hPCg8_XIiWGG9F-juL1dmG2Z5psncuXPOzIgLdIxbFM=)
I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment.
But friend, my mom never wavered once. **Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life.**
I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family.
**Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort.** There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems.
But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me.
My ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. **These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort.**
Far-right Republicans have fought for major cuts to Social Security and blocked efforts to expand Medicare, leaving seniors living paycheck to paycheck. Instead they want to cut or privatize these critical public programs — my opponent Rick Scott actually came up with a plan to _end_ them altogether. Even though I've been able to give my mom a good retirement, the shortcomings of these programs still make it incredibly hard to get her the care and support she needs.
**Every American deserves a good, stable retirement. That's why I'm running for Senate — to fight for people like my mom.[Polls show that we've got a real chance to win, but I'm counting on your help to power my grassroots campaign. clean_body: playing dominoes with my mom | | | Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life. = I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment. But friend, my mom never wavered once. Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life. I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family. Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort. There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems. But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me. My ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort. Far-right Republicans have fought for major cuts to Social Security and blocked efforts to expand Medicare, leaving seniors living paycheck to paycheck. Instead they want to cut or privatize these critical public programs — my opponent Rick Scott actually came up with a plan to end them altogether. Even though I've been able to give my mom a good retirement, the shortcomings of these programs still make it incredibly hard to get her the care and support she needs. Every American deserves a good, stable retirement. That's why I'm running for Senate — to fight for people like my mom.= Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue. | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you so much, Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

**[Elect a privileged, establishment-backed, milquetoast, and generic Democrat candidate? Or, elect me – Dr. Pamela Pugh, a pro-ceasefire, pro-peace, pro-people candidate and movement builder and advocate with a long track record of public service in our district. Help us make history by contributing to electing the only Black Scientist, pro-ceasefire candidate, and public health expert in this race -- please donate right now before early voting ends tonight.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90191682/489705062/-1272854636?refcode=080424endofearlyvotingFR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTIzMjQyZDYtNjk1Mi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=BlXeNL6y8jTu8nuw_SkePo-siu1HL-_b8pDylDGiUQE=)** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90191683/489705065/-1272854636?refcode=080424endofearlyvotingFR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTIzMjQyZDYtNjk1Mi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=BlXeNL6y8jTu8nuw_SkePo-siu1HL-_b8pDylDGiUQE=) Last weekend, we had an amazingly successful event where we encouraged all registered voters to come get more information on Michigan's 8th Congressional District primary by asking questions and taking some time to talk to us about the change they would like to see in Washington D.C. I was so grateful and incredibly happy with the turnout and with every voter who stopped and took a moment to chat. The results of our primary on Tuesday will be crucial for defining Michigan's role on the national stage. With the path to 270 running through Saginaw and our District, our primary election voters are uniquely positioned to shape the national agenda. So, let's make our voices heard and prioritize the issues that matter most to all of us. **Washington needs to know that we want a ceasefire in Gaza, affordable and quality healthcare, and equitable and properly funded public education for our children's future. ** **[Peter, you have helped our campaign so much already, but I know that you believe just as I do that this is an investment for our pro-ceasefire, pro-people, pro-worker grassroots movement. We face big donors with deeper pockets, so every grassroots donation counts. Will you donate right now before early voting ends to help us get as many souls to the polls as we possibly can today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90191684/489705067/-1272854636?refcode=080424endofearlyvotingFR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTIzMjQyZDYtNjk1Mi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=BlXeNL6y8jTu8nuw_SkePo-siu1HL-_b8pDylDGiUQE=)** **[RUSH A DONATION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90191685/489705068/-1272854636?refcode=080424endofearlyvotingFR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTIzMjQyZDYtNjk1Mi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=BlXeNL6y8jTu8nuw_SkePo-siu1HL-_b8pDylDGiUQE=)** Thank you for your help! Dr. Pamela Pugh |
* * *
_I’m Dr. Pamela Pugh, and I’m a Saginaw native running for Congress in Michigan's 8th District. I've spent my career fighting to improve the lives of Michigan residents through public health initiatives, and as the Chief Public Health Advisor for Flint I played a pivotal role in standing alongside Flint residents during the water crisis. Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

I am sure you didn't wake up on this lovely Sunday morning, spring out of bed and scream, _"Today is the day I am going to donate to Elissa Slotkin to hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats!"_

But I am emailing in the hope that you will consider contributing today anyway. Here’s why:

**Michigan's primary is in 2 days.**

This is the date that's been circled on our calendars since we launched last year. And it means we have 90 days left to sprint to the general election.

It is impossible to overstate the importance of entering the general election as strong as possible.

**Michigan is going to be one of the closest, most competitive and expensive Senate races in the country this year. Recent polling shows a dead-heat in both the Senate and the Presidential races, which means we have two competitive elections to win.**

Donations a month or two from now – when we’re in the home stretch of the sprint – are important. But to be frank, donations now, as we recently entered the 100 day window for the general election, are even more important. Because they allow us to execute a strategic plan for the general election that we've been preparing for months, rather than cobbling together a plan as donations come in piecemeal.

clean_body: | I am sure you didn't wake up on this lovely Sunday morning, spring out of bed and scream, "Today is the day I am going to donate to Elissa Slotkin to hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats!" But I am emailing in the hope that you will consider contributing today anyway. Here’s why: Michigan's primary is in 2 days. This is the date that's been circled on our calendars since we launched last year. And it means we have 90 days left to sprint to the general election. It is impossible to overstate the importance of entering the general election as strong as possible. Michigan is going to be one of the closest, most competitive and expensive Senate races in the country this year. Recent polling shows a dead-heat in both the Senate and the Presidential races, which means we have two competitive elections to win. Donations a month or two from now – when we’re in the home stretch of the sprint – are important. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Add your name to sign on as a grassroots co-sponsor and support my American Housing and Economic Mobility Act
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2298%2E4032634%2E6YWIU7)
---
You don’t need me to tell you this: **housing costs are out of control.** In almost every community — rural, suburban, urban — it’s getting harder to rent a home and harder to put together a down payment. Forty years ago, the average home in the Boston area cost about 4.5 times the salary of a Boston Public School teacher. Today, that home costs nearly _11 times_ a public school teacher’s salary. For renters, it’s no easier. Rent in Massachusetts is now more expensive than in any other state in the country. Between 2020 and 2021, rent in the Commonwealth jumped a whopping 21%. The cause of this crisis is not a secret: We don’t have enough housing. It’s Econ 101. Across the country, we are over 7 million units short of what we need. And in Massachusetts, experts say that we need at least 175,000 new housing units right now for everyone to have a place to call home. This housing problem is not going to solve itself. Local governments do not have the resources to address the problem alone. State governments cannot tackle this problem by themselves. Washington must act. **That’s why I’m introducing the American Housing and Economic Mobility Act of 2024** alongside Senator Raphael Warnock, Representative Emanuel Cleaver, and dozens of my colleagues in the House and Senate. This bill is laser-focused on increasing the housing supply — for first-time, first-generation homebuyers, renters, seniors, people with disabilities, veterans, people with no homes, workers, students — pretty much everyone who isn’t already rich and already a homeowner. **According to an independent economic analysis, my bill’s investment would create or rehabilitate nearly 3 million housing units, and it would also lower rents for middle- and working-class families by about 10% — amounting to average savings of about $140 a month.** [**If you’re ready to help pass this powerfully important legislation, add your name to sign on as a grassroots co-sponsor. And let’s get it done.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/EMZ21Z_ENG_E_20240804_V1S1/?refcode=EMZ21Z_ENG_E_20240804_V1S1&t=8&akid=2298%2E4032634%2E6YWIU7) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/EMZ21Z_ENG_E_20240804_V1S1/?refcode=EMZ21Z_ENG_E_20240804_V1S1&t=9&akid=2298%2E4032634%2E6YWIU7)
---
In addition to providing federal investment, my bill also encourages local innovation to build even more housing so that we can close the housing gap.
It creates a new innovation fund, so if a community comes up with a good idea to lower housing costs — whether it’s zoning reforms or reworking inspection scheduling — they can get federal dollars to help make that happen.
And as more housing is built, those federal dollars can be used to support that new housing however the community wants: build a new elementary school, construct a new T-stop, revitalize a decaying downtown — whatever the community decides.
One more thing about the bill: it’s fully paid for. How? By making a few changes to the estate tax so that America’s wealthiest give a tiny slice of their millions and billions to fix this crisis. By bringing back rates from the end of the George W. Bush Administration and setting slightly higher rates for the richest of the rich, we can fully pay for this investment in our country.
Now, maybe you can already hear the naysayers in your head, claiming there’s no way we can get all this done.

[**The American Housing and Economic Mobility Act is the breakthrough legislation we need to finally bring down housing costs and level the playing field so working families everywhere can find a decent place to live at a decent price. Add your name to say you support it.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/EMZ21Z_ENG_E_20240804_V1S1/?refcode=EMZ21Z_ENG_E_20240804_V1S1&t=10&akid=2298%2E4032634%2E6YWIU7)

We're in the final countdown to the primaries! Hooray - we're making history together!

subject: Who rules whom?
body:

Hillsdale College

What do you think of the Electoral College?

Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its
National Referendum on the Administrative State.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWykwxoWPN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

Hillsdale College has selected you to
participate in its National Referendum on the Administrative
State.

Responding will only take a few
minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right
away…because our country is facing a constitutional
crisis.

It's a crisis that involves a
fundamental political question: who rules whom?

The Constitution established a limited
government in which the people ruled through their elected
officials. Under this form of government, America became the
freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional
system is one that increasingly exists in name only.

The Constitution of "We the People" is
being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable
administrative state that rules without the consent of American
citizens.

This means we live in an era of growing
bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state
that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers,
and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

But we can't just TALK about the
problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION-to DO SOMETHING about it,
while there's still time to save our country.

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to
returning to the Constitution of "We the People"-before it's too
late.

To do that, I need your input. What are
your opinions on this topic-knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS
that will restore liberty?

Please let me know your thoughts today
by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State
using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63442603:WykwxoWPN:m:3:2532013465:BF012DB84CA7D6FF541BF0D0A746D773:r

When you send in your survey, I hope
you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is
a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale
sponsors several educational outreach efforts-including Imprimis,
free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus,
and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and
homeschoolers-to teach citizens about the meaning of the
Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of
liberty.

Your gift of at least $15-or even $25,
$35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE
ACTION-will help us to expand these educational initiatives that
are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is
essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of
government funding.

So please complete your National
Referendum on the Administrative State and consider giving your
most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the
Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty
Since 1844

P.S. I look forward to receiving your
opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that
you can support our work.

So please complete the National
Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63442603:WykwxoWPN:m:3:2532013465:BF012DB84CA7D6FF541BF0D0A746D773:r

As soon as you respond, we will begin
your FREE lifetime subscription to Imprimis, Hillsdale's digest
of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If
you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication
through postal mail.

Educating millions about the
Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state
is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I
hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and
attention-and for your commitment to liberty.

| | | Donald Trump is chickening out of the September debate with Kamala Harris, and now [says he will only do it if Fox News](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tda0c3651-df8f-4995-93bc-474ba88bc3c5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) runs the debate AND can fill the audience with his supporters. He can't change it just because he's scared of losing. And he doesn't get to demand his own special "safe space" run by Fox and Trump's cult members. The Harris campaign immediately rejected this absurd proposal, and we are with them 100%. Peter – I introduced a bill that Ron DeSantis is going to _hate._

**My bill, the Fight Book Bans Act, a direct attack against DeSantis’ censorship in schools.** It’ll give school districts the funding to fight back when extremists like DeSantis try to ban books, control libraries, or otherwise mess with our students’ educations.

Because let’s be clear: Book bans aren’t just about the books. They’re an assault against our freedom. They hide _necessary_ truths. But with this bill, we’re making sure Black, brown, Hispanic, and LGBTQ+ stories get told.

[**_As long as I’m in Congress, I’ll never give up this fight. But I need your support to hold this seat against the fascists and special interests attacking students’ rights. Will you rush $27 to my campaign so I can keep fighting extremism, censorship, and fascism? >>_**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/wbR9e0wYR-DN5hYKlslivg~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRokiFRP0TQaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1wZ2U_cmVmY29kZT0yMDI0MDgwNF9lbV9mcl9iMV9ib29rYmFuYmlsbF9lbl9ycyZhbW91bnQ9MjcmY2RtYz0yazdLQ2w2d0hMdmgwdE1mMFp2NDcxbmhMM2UmcmVmY29kZTI9Mms3S0NsNndITHZoMHRNZjBadjQ3MW5oTDNlJnJlZmNvZGVjZG1jPTJrN0tDbDZ3SEx2aDB0TWYwWnY0NzFuaEwzZVcDc3BjQgpmq1Gcr2aqkHAUUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAaQ~~) **Peter, we have to act _now_ because the fascists are getting bolder by the minute.** Last year, Florida led the nation in this kind of censorship: _40% of ALL book bans nationwide happened in Florida schools._

School boards, school districts, and _students_ are on the frontlines of this war on education. **But I refuse to let fascists and Republican extremists erase the history of communities of color, or silence the voices of marginalized identities.**

That’s why we need to stand together in this fight, but I need your support to keep our movement strong – and keep me in Congress, where I can keep pushing for widespread change.
