Peter, we need Cori Bush.
She’s a courageous leader in our national fight for reproductive freedom and abortion rights. A bold legislator who centers and delivers for the people in Missouri, Massachusetts, and beyond.
Cori's organizing program is strong and deeply rooted in the community — but outside spending in her race is threatening the work she’s committed to achieving for the people who put her in power.
We’ve already seen over $12 million dumped into this race attacking Cori, because GOP mega donors and corporate interests will always be threatened by everyday people having a voice in Congress. name: Team GIFFORDS
subject: How to talk to your friends and family about gun violence
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

We’ve all been there:
You’re sitting at a gathering with family or friends and suddenly, the conversation turns political. With less than 100 days until Election Day, these conversations are bound to become even more frequent.
Instead of squirming in your chair when your relative brings up guns or voting for Trump, you should feel empowered to say something. After all, you have the ability to be a persuasive messenger to the people you care about.
**If it comes up in conversation, you can say with confidence that another four years of Donald Trump would be a major setback to our movement for gun safety. Here are some of the facts:**
* Violent crime has decreased by 15 percent under President Biden’s leadership, according to recent FBI data. During Trump’s time as president, gun homicides spiked by 34 percent.

* Nearly 44,000 people die from gun violence every year in the U.S. and gun violence is the number one cause of death for children in our country. Yet at an NRA event earlier this year, Trump bragged that his administration “did nothing” on guns.

* Assault weapons were used in seven of the deadliest mass shootings between the years of 2010 to 2020. Meanwhile, extreme members of the House and Senate won’t allow an assault weapons ban to come to the floor for a vote.

* About 90% of Americans support background checks for all gun sales. Background checks are commonsense, and help keep guns out of the hands of people with the intent to harm others.

* Biden is the most pro-gun safety president we've ever had. He signed the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ into law—the most significant federal gun safety legislation passed in nearly 30 years. Among many historic actions, this legislation expanded background checks and provided schools and communities with funding for mental health resources and community violence intervention programs.

Friends, don’t be afraid to use your voice. This November’s elections are the most important ones of our lifetimes. Help the people you care about stay informed about the American gun violence crisis, and let them know that the **_only**_ presidential candidate who will keep our communities safe from gun violence is Vice President Kamala Harris.
\- The team at GIFFORDS
* * *

**👋 Hey there, before you go...**

If everyone reading this donated just $20, we'd have the resources to take on the gun lobby and elect gun safety champions up and down the ballot this November. But not everyone gives -- that makes it even more important for people who care and understand the stakes of our struggle to chip in what they can.

If $20 seems worth it to you to change our gun laws in order to make our communities safer from gun violence, we're asking you to [**contribute to GIFFORDS PAC today.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240804-1-30&t=1&akid=8638%2E3935704%2EkCn5Kw)

Peter, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=d2d0a585097d4a9fbf0c9a34f31e65db&_e=7lfotCN0lOAYP4LrGtM7PuRcI6b2_Go2a-of8pb-Yzabgh4gve3QimwYHO1biZ6HZFOzf09006jPbgvCRWTfBX-1zRkneM__ShoGs0e5Uc8Niv4yknLtn3J3X178_UT4eHWIl3xelIYQerEZOu6iZ-nFHEJmwNJm42vdQuWh205o9dWb7ZOoyzSjxohXtiavK4vcydsgmgH72b_kE18SGmgOW_W-at2CEzIhn18nlKauoxj0wRG6KZ6v-iz-bzWl62CMfJCyZg0HTMoM0otqWg%3D%3D)

| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=d2d0a585097d4a9fbf0c9a34f31e65db&_e=7lfotCN0lOAYP4LrGtM7PuRcI6b2_Go2a-of8pb-Yzabgh4gve3QimwYHO1biZ6HZFOzf09006jPbgvCRWTfBX-1zRkneM__ShoGs0e5Uc8Niv4yknLtn3J3X178_UT42u8mImfa-0fRPT3hw1td_HexDBZjf5xpnAHVLc7xTUm-lLBh0u67bdrMfOhSSHY6LtGF4hZp-53Dj5QqrMI0B1Zblj9SVC2rCYpG5W2ORyNcgX-s34PbgMu9aXUFzR-xVENXNMxnOJGi--Bi7xluzQ%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.

Please help
| Friend, I’m Riley Gaines. You may have heard my name in the news. I’m an All-American swimmer -- but I’m better known for my role in the fight to save women’s sports.
Women and girls have a right to compete fairly, and to private locker rooms. I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men. **Just this year, a female golfer lost her spot in the U.S. Women’s Open qualifier at Bradenton to a man, James “Hailey” Davidson.** Then, USA Today _took down_ a brilliant op-ed by Republican Senator John Kennedy. In the op-ed, he demanded to know if “inclusion” should be prioritized over fairness and safety when it comes to sports. But Friend, I won’t be censored! Instead, I seek to build a community of thousands of sensible Americans who know the difference between a man and a woman. I started the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute so that women would have a place to speak out against the gender ideology radicals. Leora Levy - Former National Republican Committeewoman and US Senate candidate
I wholeheartedly endorse Dr. Michael Goldstein as the Republican candidate to oppose Jim Himes in the race for the 4th District Congressional seat.
I know Michael to be a reliable, common sense, principled Conservative who is the best candidate to represent the 4th District in Congress. As a medical doctor and an attorney, he brings a perspective that his opponent lacks. As a physician, he is focused on curing and solving problems for his patients. That will be the attitude he brings when it comes to serving his constituents. Michael will seek to cure and solve the problems America faces as a result of the progressive policies passed by past Congress's (voted for by Jim Himes) and imposed on us the bloated regulatory bureaucracy that makes everything more expensive and controls our lives. As a lawyer, he will also be able to challenge those laws and regulations in the next Congress.
Today, as we watch horrified while Male DNA boxers are allowed to beat up women in Women's Boxing (and win medals for it!) at the Olympics, physically injuring and stealing lifelong dreams of those women, we need representatives in Washington, DC who oppose allowing men in women's sports, locker rooms and bathrooms on scientific, moral and common sense grounds. As a physician, Michael will stand up for women and for Title IX as originally conceived and approved not this Biden-Harris-Himes version that erases women from women's sports and indecently violates their right to privacy.
Goldstein will vote to close the border to end the invasion of our country by tens of millions of illegal aliens including, criminals, gang members, terrorists and human traffickers. As a result , the American People have suffered the poisoning of our children and adults by fentanyl, increased crime in our neighborhoods and cities, and the theft of services intended for American citizens by illegal aliens. We are also in danger of terrorism in America. Women and children are being raped and trafficked and American women have been raped and murdered. Every single person who has entered our country illegally has committed a crime. Even if they are otherwise good people, they are here illegally and must be held accountable. As your Congressman, unlike Jim Himes, Michael will vote to deport them.
Michael has been endorsed by the State Police Union and will work to support our police and reduce crime by increasing funding for police and by restoring qualified immunity to our police.
Michael is a fiscal conservative who will vote to reduce taxes and reduce wasteful spending to help our Economy grow thereby helping every American to prosper again.
Michael favors restoring American Energy Independence and will vote to restore and increase American Energy Production crushed by Himes, Biden and Harris. This will be key to creating Economic Growth, Jobs and Prosperity for all. It will also hurt our enemies: Russia and Iran!
Jim Himes opposed the SAVE Act which sought to protect the integrity of our elections, in other words to protect the value of YOUR legal vote by requiring Voter ID and proof of citizenship. Himes and 197 other Democrats voted against the SAVE Act. Michael Goldstein will vote for it, making sure that our elections are free, fair and transparent.
> Goldstein is a strong supporter of Israel and a strong opponent of Antisemitism. He will vote to supply the weapons that our ally, Israel needs to defend itself and defeat the terrorists that threaten to exterminate Israel and the Jewish People.
For these and many other reasons, I strongly endorse Dr. Michael Goldstein for Congress.
Leora R. Levy
Republican National Committeewoman - CT 2016-2024
Republican Candidate US Senate - 2022

body:

| **Antonellis Puts America, Massachusetts, Womanhood, First**
**Antonellis for U.S. Senate [R-MA]**
Dear Fellow Patriotic American;
I’m Bob Antonellis and I'm running for Senate. Many ask me why.
The reason is very simple. Our Republic started here. If we look back to 1770 and the roots of revolution, we find them in Boston. Ordinary people rose up against an oppressive force that was depriving them and degrading their rights as free born citizens. Don’t we face just such a theft of our rights, today, thrust down our throats by the Massachusetts status as a Sanctuary State? I will fight to end this theft on Day One.
And what about men competing in women’s sports? Isn’t that just a different kind of oppression?
**My top priorities in the Senate will include** the Trump agenda, critically important issues for Massachusetts, and a new fresh discussion to end the social collapse:• The America First Agenda• The Massachusetts First Agenda• The Womanhood First Agenda
I have been an America Firster since birth, and have fought for our great country for my entire life. So, I am happy that Trump introduced the term, “America First”. It allows me to say that when I win the GOP Primary, ANTONELLIS v. WARREN would become America First versus America Last, the position staked out by all Democrats, and especially Elizabeth Warren. Dead last.
**Most already know what America First includes:** • Strong border, an end to illegal immigration • Reverse skyrocketing inflation of food, fuel and housing prices • Fight the explosion in crime and fentanyl deaths • End the endless wars and get to the bottom of the Afghanistan pullout• Win the release of all America hostages in GAZA, Afghanistan and elsewhere• Enable Israel to defend itself• And much more...
This is the agenda we all feel so natural talking about, but which sounds literally toxic to so many leftists. People like Elizabeth Warren, who has her fingerprints on every problem that I mentioned, as she rubber-stamps every broken policy out of the Biden White House, and the Harris Administration, should she and Harris win in November.I am adding a new term to our discussion, “Massachusetts First,” so we can quickly identify the benefactor of my work on the Senate floor. We all love America, but MA must be our primary focus, and a big benefactor of government projects, Federal Funding, etc.
**Bob’s Massachusetts First agenda will include:** • Ending Massachusetts’s Sanctuary State Status• Returning all illegals to where they came from• Enforcement of SCOTUS decisions, including Gun Rights, Free Speech, Religious Liberties, etc.• Ending ZERO CASH BAIL, convicting criminals, and enforcing the laws• Protecting the people with Constitutional Carry for U.S. Citizens• Banning offshore wind turbines in all U.S. Territorial Waters, and especially around Cape Cod• Making Massachusetts a great global tourist destination, once again
I love the state and have lived in Massachusetts for over 40-years, of my 62-years, including Hanover, Norwell, Sandwich, Duxbury, Amherst, South Dennis, Waltham, Pittsfield, Wareham, Arlington, Marshfield and Medford. My campaign has brought me to many other parts of the state, and I do love it all.Lastly, I am fighting to put Womanhood First, since Womanhood is under grave assault today, and from so many places. I believe that Womanhood and Motherhood are the “glue”, which hold together Western Civilization, where the love and commitment of a mother to her child is the origins of what binds the family together. From the nuclear family, comes the extended family of neighbors, classmates, the workplace, and beyond, where simple acts of kindness and compassion are shown to perfect strangers, throughout this great country. **Bob’s Womanhood First agenda will include:** • Shut the Border! So many women are raped, trafficked, and murdered by illegal aliens, who invade our country and put America’s women at grave risk to harm, injury and death.• A Federal Ban on Sharia Law, tight regulations on the Burke, the Hijab• A Federal Ban on men and boys competing in female sports, boys in the girl’s room• A Federal Ban on the use of schools, class material, etc. to confuse children into questioning their own biological sex. • A ban on Massachusetts hospitals performing gender surgeries on minors, and even such surgeries on adults.• Constitutional Carry in all 50 states and U.S. Territories
Lastly, when you consider that women are the smaller and physically weaker sex, you will agree, the Gun Grab, as we are seeing unfold in Massachusetts, disproportionately impacts women. FROM: A proud Democrat **Dear Vice President Kamala Harris,

_I am SO excited to have you as our President!_**

You and President Biden have accomplished SO much for our country — from lowering healthcare costs to tackling the climate crisis and so much more.

Peter, check out
this headline from Jezebel:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240804-2-cb.mIDaZK&refcode=em20240804-35877&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=35877%2E1203867%2EO1-9WJ ]Cori Bush’s Democratic Primary Could Cost the Party Its Reproductive
Justice Champion. “My district isn’t for sale, and it’s not going to be
just a stepping stone in a politician’s career,” Bush told Jezebel about
the states for abortion rights in her race and the outsized role of
lobbyist groups like AIPAC.

It’s true: our progressive incumbent Cori Bush could be ousted from
Congress this Tuesday by a man who managed the campaign of an
anti-abortion Republican. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240804-2-cb.mIDaZK&refcode=em20240804-35877&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=35877%2E1203867%2EO1-9WJ ]Help Cori and Justice Democrats fight back
NOW →

Cori has been a reproductive rights champion since Day 1 in office,
courageously sharing her own abortion story after she was raped at the age
of 17, introducing and co-sponsoring legislation to protect abortion
access, and becoming the first Democrat to demand a repeal of the Comstock
Act.

While Wesley Bell claims he’s pro-abortion and tried misleading voters
into thinking he was endorsed by Planned Parenthood (he wasn’t — Cori
was), he’s accepted millions of dollars in help from the same
anti-abortion Republican megadonors who support Josh Hawley and the author
of Missouri’s abortion ban, and chose to work directly for an
anti-abortion conservative himself.

As Jezebel stated, Cori is “one of the Democratic Party’s most compelling
voices in the fight for reproductive rights.” We can’t afford to let her
be ousted by a liar and a hypocrite who’s bankrolled by anti-abortion
extremists.

With this critical primary election is less than two days away, this is
one of our last opportunities to boost our resources so we can turn out
enough voters to win and re-elect our reproductive rights champion.

name: Jill Stein
subject: Kamala has a message for migrants and asylum seekers
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_immigration&n=1)
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_immigration&n=2)
---
Peter,

_“Do not come.”

_ That’s what Vice President Harris had to say to a group of asylum seekers gathered in Guatemala in June 2021.

She addressed a group suspected to be traveling to the U.S. border to attempt to gain entry to the U.S., and went on to emphasize that the U.S. will “enforce our laws” and they would be “turned back” – taking time to emphasize the need to migrate “the right away.”

Let’s talk about what “the right way” entails.

The New York Times has reported that 40% of all migrants crossing the border today are parents and their children.

These are people who have tried to assert their legal right to asylum by following the process, seeking an appointment for a hearing of their claim. But as Democrats and Republicans in Congress have deprived the immigration courts of the funding they need to process those claims, they’re often waiting 10 months or more just to get an appointment.

The lucky ones get a space in one of the handful of migrant centers operated by nonprofits on the Mexican side of the border. **The rest are left to live on the street where they are targeted by cartels for extortion, exploitation, or worse.** No shock, then, that many choose to risk crossing the border on foot.

**These families are fleeing political persecution, cartel violence, and economic devastation that is largely the product of American policy.

** Now that she has been anointed as the new Democratic nominee for president, one of the first promises Harris made on immigration was to pass Biden’s barbaric “bipartisan border security” bill.

Experts and advocates have estimated that an additional $1 billion of annual funding is needed to expand immigration courts and properly resource the agencies tasked with processing migrant workers and asylum claims – far less than the $14 billion this bill pours into militarizing the border and hiring more border patrol agents.

**When I am elected, we will address both the immediate material needs of asylum seekers and the root causes driving migration.**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_immigration&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_immigration&n=3)
---
**There is no daylight between Republican and Democratic policies on the border** , and it’s no surprise that Harris – a former, self-proclaimed “tough on crime” prosecutor – has promised to carry her border militancy forward.

I will grant her this: Harris’ hostility to human rights falls right in line with Joe Biden’s.

I’m looking for something very different in my running mate.

**My team and I sought a vice president who shares my commitment to protecting the human rights and civil liberties of immigrants.

****_We found one._**[**_And you will meet them very soon._**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/vprally?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_immigration&n=4)

When we are elected, we will completely overhaul the broken and abusive immigration system and honor our obligation to asylum seekers – whose desperate plight has been largely created by predatory US policies.

We will create a timely, ethical, transparent, and dignified path to citizenship for immigrants, asylum seekers, and refugees.

You can read our full immigration policy at [**jillstein2024.com/platform**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=Qj32F8ZTIcBOzthgR25-gF2J_V8cRlHgwGIBI_1lcLQ0Ce7w_K4rbPSVLguxOifF&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_immigration&n=5).

And you can help make this a reality by supporting our campaign for people, planet, and peace. Your contributions will help ensure that every American can vote for the only pro-worker, anti-war, climate action campaign with a pathway to the White House this November.
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_immigration&n=6 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_immigration&n=6)
---
Seeking asylum is a basic human right. It’s also a legal right under U.S. federal law. It is our duty to offer safe harbor to people escaping violence that we brought to their shores in the first place!

When I am president, we will.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

We’ve zeroed in on critical elections where our work will make an outsized difference to elect fair maps champions — and it’s only possible with crucial early support. **But there’s a lot more to be done in the next three months — and truth be told, we're quickly running out of time to get it all done. That’s where you come in, Peter.** The average online donation to the NDRC is about $35. By donating $12 a month starting today (when it matters most!), those contributions will add up to $36 by Election Day, and they will have an _even greater_ impact than that same amount given right before November 5. That’s because earlier, ongoing support makes it easier to plan our investments in critical elections. [**Will you start a monthly gift of whatever you can today? We need everyone to stand up and speak out... | | | | | |
---
| Peter,

**Our campaign is picking up steam, but we need your help to keep up the fight against entrenched political interests.**

Richard Hudson, career politician, has a history of voting along strict party lines, getting tons of cash from corporate PACs, and voting against key bills that support veterans. He represents the very partisanship and gridlock that Shelane Etchison is determined to change.

Hudson is a powerful incumbent, but make no mistake, Shelane is ready for the fight. As a decorated Special Operations Soldier, Shelane has overcome immense challenges before. Her unwavering determination, proven leadership, and commitment to putting people above party politics is why she is the perfect candidate to bring genuine change to Washington.

**Why We Need Your Help

** This is the first time we're asking for your support, and this is why. With enough resources, we can boost our visibility through TV, radio, and social media, making sure Shelane's message reaches every corner of the district. Donations also help us mobilize volunteers and implement effective strategies like door-to-door canvassing and phone banking to persuade voters and drive turnout on election day.

**Here’s How You Can Help**

| | _Join our team and help with phone banking, canvassing, and organizing events. Every effort counts!_

Stay in touch,

Joe Stenger _Chief of Staff, Etchison for Congress_

subject: Milton Friedman: Why Government is the Problem
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Dear Friend,

The major social problems of the United
States-deteriorating education, lawlessness and crime,
homelessness, the collapse of family values, the crisis in
medical care-all have one thing in common. They have all been
produced by the well-intended actions of the government.

And yet, for some reason, more and more Americans
look to government as the solution to their problems.

That's why I want you to have a free digital copy
of Milton Friedman's Why Government Is the Problem.

In this eBook, Friedman uses his humble and direct
style to:

Analyze the continuing social and economic
problems as government intervention increases in the U.S.

Shed light on the government and its tilt
toward special interests over citizen interests.

Demonstrate how and why government is the
problem.

I really think you'll get a lot out of this eBook.
It's a favorite among supporters of Hoover. And although some of
the particulars have changed since he wrote this in 1993, I think
you'll find the situation is frighteningly similar today.

Please use this link to get access to your copy of
Why Government Is the Problem now.

Thank you,

Greg

Greg Stamps | Online Development

Hoover Institution | Stanford University

With its eminent scholars and world-renowned
Library and Archives, the Hoover Institution is a non-partisan,
data-driven policy research organization that seeks to improve
the human condition by advancing ideas that promote economic
prosperity, national security, and democratic governance. Over
more than one hundred years, Hoover's work has directly led to
policies that have produced greater freedom, democracy, and
opportunity in the United States and around the world.

Friend — I’m Eugene Vindman, the official Democratic nominee for Virginia’s 7th district. Give me just a moment to tell you the story of a phone call that changed everything. My brother Alex and I used to serve on the White House National Security Council. I was the senior ethics official on the Council. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90209178/489761513/191792663?refcode=240804&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZmNlMWU5Mi04ZTUyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=39-y8QXZXB5G0ZwvCkjQWq9WnQKIxlP-6fBvewaNlJg=) In 2019, Alex overheard a phone call in which President Trump attempted to extort our allies in Ukraine. Trump threatened to withhold military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated his political rival. After Alex reported the call to me, we both blew the whistle on Trump. We reported Trump’s corrupt phone call up the chain of command, and it led to his impeachment. Even though the decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump was the right thing to do, it cost my brother and me our military careers after the former-president retaliated against us. But I am not done serving. **I’m running for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.** And more than that, I’m running to push our country forward across the board. To restore abortion rights everywhere, act on climate change, and lower costs for working families. So here’s the deal. If we win Virginia’s 7th district, we win a highly competitive swing district and make it that much more likely that Democrats take back the House. And if we take back the House, we can begin to make progress on those issues while safeguarding against any Republican attempts to roll back our rights. So please: [**Split a contribution between me and Serve America to support my campaign for Congress. Help us build a real grassroots movement in defense of democracy.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90209179/489761514/191792663?refcode=240804&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZmNlMWU5Mi04ZTUyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=39-y8QXZXB5G0ZwvCkjQWq9WnQKIxlP-6fBvewaNlJg=) Thanks for hearing me out. I hope I can count on your support. — Eugene Vindman

Now, colleges and universities regularly silence conservative viewpoints and discriminate against students eager to learn your conservative values.

Enough is enough. We conservatives need to stop giving our money to institutions that counter our values!

clean_body: We need to show Cori that we have her back — especially in the face of the increased attacks. | | | Peter, With just two days left until Cori Bush’s election, AIPAC and their MAGA donors have stooped to a new low. According to The Intercept ,1 AIPAC’s super PAC, United Democracy Project, has been using mailers that “make her forehead look bigger and elongate her features” while also altering the color of her skin. It’s repulsive. And another example of how there is no lie too-big or too-gross as long as their preferred candidates get elected. And if you’re not in a position to contribute financially, the next best thing you can do is Using racist caricatures — financed by right-wing billionaires and Donald Trump donors — to oust a true working class champion is about as heinous as it gets. And since the initial reporting on Wednesday, AIPAC has spent even more money on their wall-to-wall TV, radio, and mailer ads. As of today, AIPAC has now poured $8.8 million 2 to defeat Cori Bush. That’s two-thirds of all of her opponent’s financial support. We need to show Cori that we have her back — especially in the face of the increased attacks. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , The Intercept, July 31, 2024. 2\. , AdImpact Politics, August 1, 2024. Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. name: Tim Kaine
subject: We can flip Virginia’s 1st Congressional District blue!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie]
The road to a Democratic majority in the House runs straight through Virginia. I’m proud to support strong VA Democrats who are running for U.S. House seats, and I hope you’ll join me by reading these emails and chipping in when you can. With your help, we can flip the House and keep Virginia blue!
Friends,
I’m honored to support Leslie Mehta’s campaign for U.S. Congress! Leslie is a civil rights attorney, mom, and proud Democrat who is determined to fight for our most fundamental rights while restoring balance and compassionate leadership in Congress.
Leslie is the Democratic nominee in Virginia’s 1st Congressional district, and she’s going to need our support to flip the district blue. Will you split a donation of any amount between me and Leslie Mehta right now to fuel our campaigns through November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie]
Leslie has a long track record of advocating for others and protecting our essential freedoms. She’s worked as a litigator and a civil rights attorney — serving her community at every step.
She’s also a pragmatist who knows how to work with people across the aisle and get things done. Leslie has been appointed by both Democratic and Republican governors to serve our Commonwealth and successfully worked with Democrats and Republicans in Congress to secure federal funding for rare diseases — an issue that is deeply personal to her and her family.
Today, Leslie is fighting to bring meaningful change to children and families in her community. Like many of us, she worries about the future we’re creating for our children, and she wants to ensure a better life for them.
In Congress, Leslie will work to protect and expand reproductive freedoms, invest in public school education, pass gun safety reforms, and expand access to affordable healthcare.
As a fellow civil rights attorney, I’d be particularly proud and honored to work alongside Leslie Mehta in Congress, but it’s a tough election cycle, and we’re going to need your help along the way.
Will you please split a donation of any amount between our campaigns? Together we can help elect Leslie and flip the House blue on Election Day. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie]
Thanks so much for your support — and for helping elect strong Virginia Democrats up and down the ballot this November.
-Tim Kaine

Hey there,
**My name is Dan Osborn, and I am the candidate running for U.S. Senate against Republican Deb Fischer here in Nebraska.**
I know what you’re thinking. I get a lot of eye rolls when I say the word Nebraska and tell people that I’m running against a Republican. A lot of people don’t think we can win against a two-term incumbent who has an (R) next to her name. But give me the chance to explain why they’re wrong.
The people of Nebraska are ready for change. **The polls show just 24% of Nebraskan voters approve of Republican Deb Fischer – and in one poll, I am LEADING by 2 points! Seriously.**
Nebraskans are fed up with Washington. Both parties – Democrats and Republicans – are full of too many people that have been bought and paid for by corporations and billionaires. The Republicans don’t look out for blue-collar working people like me, and too many Democrats in DC don’t seem to understand rural America anymore.
I’m not rich, and I don’t come from some political dynasty. **I’ve got no business running for the U.S. Senate – and that’s _exactly_ why I am.**
I am a proud card-carrying steamfitter and mechanic. I was president of my local union before I got fired for leading a strike that saved 500 middle-class jobs in Nebraska. I served in the United States Navy and joined the National Guard to help pay for college before I had to drop out so I could keep food on the table for my family.
There’s nobody like me in the Senate. But with your help, I believe we can win and finally elect a senator whose collars are blue. And this new poll showing me in the lead proves it.

body:
It’s a line that’s caught fire lately because it’s so true.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240804-1&t=1&akid=1021%2E587540%2ETH00Hl)
MAGA Republicans are weird, Peter.
It’s a line that’s caught fire lately because it’s so true. The things they’re obsessed with, the things they say, the policies they push for... They’re racist, sexist, and anti-democratic, obviously, but they’re also just straight up weird!
Just the other day Donald Trump told the National Association of Black Journalists that Kamala Harris all of a sudden **“became Black”** when she started running for president. _And J.D. Vance backed him up on it!_
Racist? Yes. Weird? Also yes!
[**Leaders We Deserve is working to elect young people who care about actual problems — and who understand that biracial people exist — but we need your help. Will you pitch in $5 to support our work today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240804-1?refcode=em20240804-1&amount=5&refcode2=1021_587540_TH00Hl&akid=1021%2E587540%2ETH00Hl)
And Peter, that’s just the most recent example. Republicans’ weird behavior stretches back for _years_. Here are a few more examples:
* J.D. Vance is on tape saying things like **“it’s too easy to get a divorce”** and we should **“punish”** **childless people**.

* **Mike Johnson bragged about using "accountability software"** so he and his son can monitor what each other does on the internet. (Ew)

* A ton of Republicans have spent the last couple days angrily **(and falsely)** accusing an Algerian woman competing in women’s boxing at the Olympics of being trans.

* **Their entire party has fully dedicated itself to the whims of one guy, Donald Trump.** Even though with the exception of 2016, they’ve lost every election they’ve had with him as the leader of their party!

It’s all very, very weird. But the good news is we’ve already elected a couple of fantastic young leaders who are pushing back against this BS, and we’re working around the clock to elect even more across the country this November.
While MAGA claims to want freedom, they invade your bedroom, exam room, and want to dictate what books kids read instead of letting teachers do their job.
Meanwhile our candidates want people to have healthcare and the freedom to do what you want with your own body — and to make sure kids survive math class. After all, when is the last time kids died in a mass reading? We need to ban guns. Not books.
[**If you’re tired of these weirdos and want to make sure we elect the leaders we deserve this November, will you pitch in $5 today to support our work?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240804-1?refcode=em20240804-1&amount=5&refcode2=1021_587540_TH00Hl&akid=1021%2E587540%2ETH00Hl)

body:
We need reform, and we need it now.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90212994/489775020/1328794144?refcode=ea.f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY5YmFkMjUxLWEwNTItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8EJWM-BAYhfQuFzBE_kKytPqarte47wTT8QH9uQwaIw=&emci=20d70bd3-fe50-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105)

The Supreme Court has made some _deeply troubling_ decisions lately — decisions that threaten our rights, our environment, and the very fabric of our democracy. Here’s some good news: President Biden proposed several bold reforms to address these issues, including **term limits for Supreme Court justices** to end lifetime appointments and create a more predictable and fair nomination process and a **binding code of conduct for justices** , which would enforce ethical standards and hold justices accountable for their actions. **But we want to hear from you: Do you support reforming the Supreme Court?** | [**YES**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90212996/489775022/-957683364?refcode=ea.f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY5YmFkMjUxLWEwNTItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8EJWM-BAYhfQuFzBE_kKytPqarte47wTT8QH9uQwaIw=&emci=20d70bd3-fe50-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105) | [**NO**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90212998/489775024/-957683364?refcode=ea.f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY5YmFkMjUxLWEwNTItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8EJWM-BAYhfQuFzBE_kKytPqarte47wTT8QH9uQwaIw=&emci=20d70bd3-fe50-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105)
---|---
We’re all aware of the majority’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , but few know about the Court’s decision to destroy the _Chevron_ doctrine earlier this year, which served as a precedent for over 40 years of environmental protections.
The decision to strike down _Chevron_ effectively stripped the EPA of its power to regulate based on science and expertise, giving unelected judges the final say on critical and complex environmental issues. _Yes — justices like Clarence Thomas and Brett Kavanaugh._
The Supreme Court even granted presidential immunity from federal prosecution for any official actions during their tenure — giving a free pass to abuses of power and demolishing any shred of accountability.
And let’s not forget the scandals. 🙄 Reports of billionaires giving millions of dollars in unreported lavish gifts and luxury vacations to influence the Court’s decisions are making headlines. _Clarence Thomas, we’re looking at you._
We’re at a tipping point. The Supreme Court is not just out of touch; it’s out of control. It’s time for serious reform to restore integrity and balance to our highest court.
While these reforms face an uphill battle in a divided Congress, they highlight the urgent need for change.
At the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we know that the fight for a sustainable future is inseparable from the fight for a fair and accountable judiciary.
**We need a Supreme Court that upholds justice and protects our planet — not one that panders to billionaires and corporate interests. And we need to know if you’re with us. Do you agree that it’s time to reform the Supreme Court?**
[**YES**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90213000/489775026/-957683364?refcode=ea.f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY5YmFkMjUxLWEwNTItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8EJWM-BAYhfQuFzBE_kKytPqarte47wTT8QH9uQwaIw=&emci=20d70bd3-fe50-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105) | [**NO**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90213002/489775028/-957683364?refcode=ea.f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY5YmFkMjUxLWEwNTItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8EJWM-BAYhfQuFzBE_kKytPqarte47wTT8QH9uQwaIw=&emci=20d70bd3-fe50-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=f9bad251-a052-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105)

clean_body: We need reform, and we need it now. | The Supreme Court has made some deeply troubling decisions lately — decisions that threaten our rights, our environment, and the very fabric of our democracy. Here’s some good news: President Biden proposed several bold reforms to address these issues, including term limits for Supreme Court justices to end lifetime appointments and create a more predictable and fair nomination process and a binding code of conduct for justices , which would enforce ethical standards and hold justices accountable for their actions. But we want to hear from you: Do you support reforming the Supreme Court? | | ---|--- We’re all aware of the majority’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade , but few know about the Court’s decision to destroy the Chevron doctrine earlier this year, which served as a precedent for over 40 years of environmental protections. The decision to strike down Chevron effectively stripped the EPA of its power to regulate based on science and expertise, giving unelected judges the final say on critical and complex environmental issues. Yes — justices like Clarence Thomas and Brett Kavanaugh. The Supreme Court even granted presidential immunity from federal prosecution for any official actions during their tenure — giving a free pass to abuses of power and demolishing any shred of accountability. And let’s not forget the scandals. 🙄 Reports of billionaires giving millions of dollars in unreported lavish gifts and luxury vacations to influence the Court’s decisions are making headlines. Clarence Thomas, we’re looking at you. We’re at a tipping point. The Supreme Court is not just out of touch; it’s out of control. It’s time for serious reform to restore integrity and balance to our highest court. While these reforms face an uphill battle in a divided Congress, they highlight the urgent need for change. At the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we know that the fight for a sustainable future is inseparable from the fight for a fair and accountable judiciary. We need a Supreme Court that upholds justice and protects our planet — not one that panders to billionaires and corporate interests. And we need to know if you’re with us. Do you agree that it’s time to reform the Supreme Court? | ---|--- Thanks for your response. Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=e466811d28c048749d30ca5d217a35f5&_e=82K8QXaFT11WGgMYo9Hf__qQB21C1FNpo_Ou3qiJrNfCU3fKbsuDn7gJX_k1K920Gt5Td1wCygpqGRkD8ltRsMvS3zvItSYYRMP4Gm_5t13Q-pDwNGMDyE00ZJ2pJcyJTTeEYS0E-6QNMW1fxy-5yutCl3PCLgfrrP93DCnla986uvMOmWpS-v2Xrofv7gxiLJVitTjTqtvSRQba625Cx656d2zIzgPD-a0HU4Z50x1ch2CU8V6GDuTwcNj__vw8ymVJlGq5DabJ_fPPWPwOAA%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=e466811d28c048749d30ca5d217a35f5&_e=82K8QXaFT11WGgMYo9Hf__qQB21C1FNpo_Ou3qiJrNfCU3fKbsuDn7gJX_k1K920Gt5Td1wCygpqGRkD8ltRsMvS3zvItSYYRMP4Gm_5t13Q-pDwNGMDyE00ZJ2pJcyJEKMOvxD4I96w2h88HHSCM0prHQ0FCf5G1QJmYREBuWgddif533yT5HgbhOg3wcF8p5RXAFnFKwYKXHkdpY15zGZXUDkBuX44SZraKERhFLB4gv2XKAVYeWXqHiWHkwhqXliF6DbvKW1ZKjAL8yfZYQ%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---

clean_body: Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.| | | | Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.” | | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, they censored my talk about censorship. It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission. They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us. Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. I hope you'll consider joining the fight by But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs. Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon CEO, The Babylon Bee | Copyright © 2024 Babylon Bee, All rights reserved. name: Yassamin Ansari
subject: We are within the recount margin
body:
Here's what that means
Peter, final ballots have come in for our race and while we continue to lead, as we have since the first results came out this past Tuesday, we are likely heading to a recount. Our race is within 0.5% which means an automatic recount will be triggered early next week.
Our team remains fully confident that we will come out victorious. Since we launched this campaign in April of last year, to when the first results came in, to now - we have always had the lead and never given it up. In the face of misinformation campaigns that smeared my name, background, and the Iranian-American community – we have persevered through it all and I know we will once again.
As we prepare for a recount, my team and I have already been out curing ballots: going out to voters whose ballots were rejected for any number of reasons, helping them correct the record, and making sure every vote is counted in this race because we know when all this work is done we will have made history here in AZ-03, and we have YOU to thank for that.
As my team and I pound the pavement to get final ballots cured, I'm stepping away from the phones and the fundraising efforts for these final tasks. I'm needed on the ground, and that's why I'm reaching out to you, Peter.
**Can you rush a contribution of any amount you can afford to our recount fund and final ballot-curing efforts? Even if you have already made a maximum contribution or double-maximum contribution to our campaign you can still contribute. Here's the link: [secure.actblue.com/donate/ya_rc_em](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90213389/489776428/903012709?refcode=240803_ya_bc_l1&ms=240804_ya_rc1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YjBjMzA4Zi1hMjUyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EhqQDnsus2Stp2DyDullWsEee68LR21mvkV9P3VmiFQ=)**
Thank you for your continued support,

Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=65b2a984829b477885f1fbc861687651&_e=OAZNabVs2ilnChn5GKJ3WrAfbL3BzHT8AtB3kL7N90Dk4IkimxlXUpVR9N4XNe0w2fHXPWfCK9VXQNViehbvgjMO1n2xycxDc0-IEnpHPkfJesFH1rJdM3n3np7bO5chQnAbfBsF1iiDh4uei1X3SS7Ja655j7aNufNbtk4BF3xSMET9GPdxYOLG3n8mdS-Gq7RywChh_2CFp2j5YHxxel_7aJz992gXcT3dPwgfo-KdEUZgaRWQlr7JR_TsflvYUnvSDMIjlR17aIfvy_ur3KqKuC9IcFzD0X-vhHShzynm65y2B_FChqHSn01CQHM5)_

Fellow Patriot, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

**I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE.** _**[All I ask for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=65b2a984829b477885f1fbc861687651&_e=OAZNabVs2ilnChn5GKJ3WrAfbL3BzHT8AtB3kL7N90Dk4IkimxlXUpVR9N4XNe0w2fHXPWfCK9VXQNViehbvgjMO1n2xycxDc0-IEnpHPkfJesFH1rJdM3n3np7bO5chQnAbfBsF1iiDh4uei1X3Sb8vRYL0dFfEeiyG7MjdGQD-TJvsweOcDlPAATQwQRI1iIw0K9YbhXWASANea-cBvnXB22DYN8jNvKbC0xjqZb0x68_irqoR8WgGMA-d7HYEBzW_5xXz2n8RAMosLeJ3b7b7Bbcq7ewHTW-18HL82Vcc_R-gc-TJx-Ee5gj8uq4a)**_

# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3769%2E552475%2E14c3ju)
Peter, it’s Mark Kelly.
I’m not a take-it-easy kind of person. I’m going to do whatever it takes to protect our razor-thin Senate majority. That’s why I recently visited Pennsylvania — which could determine control of the U.S. Senate — to support my friend Bob Casey who’s in his toughest re-election fight yet.
**[Before I get into it, can you chip in $5 or more to Bob’s campaign?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240804-4?recurring=1&refcode=em20240804-4&refcode2=3769_552475_14c3ju&akid=3769%2E552475%2E14c3ju)**
While I was in Philadelphia, I joined Bob to meet with some of the great men and women who served our country.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240804-4?recurring=1&refcode=em20240804-4&refcode2=3769_552475_14c3ju&akid=3769%2E552475%2E14c3ju)
I also got to try one of Bob’s favorites — a soft pretzel. I learned that there are few things more important to Team Casey than a Philly soft pretzel, but one of them is re-electing Bob so we can defend our Democratic Senate majority.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240804-4?recurring=1&refcode=em20240804-4&refcode2=3769_552475_14c3ju&akid=3769%2E552475%2E14c3ju)

Hello...

This could be the last email I ever send you, Friend.

But I have to be honest with you -- no matter how weary I am about opening up.

**Right now, the odds are stacked against us, and I need to know how you 'll react to this email to understand how to move forward. Your response could change everything.**

My name is Jim Banks. If you haven't heard of me, I'm an Afghanistan veteran from Indiana now serving in Congress.

I worked hard to serve my community alongside my wife, Amanda. And above all, I am a father to three amazing girls.

In a recent interview with CBS News, Bobby perfectly captured the immense challenges we have faced during this campaign with one powerful quote:

Even when we encountered outdated laws and inconsistent information from various Secretaries of State, **your resolve never wavered**. Your belief in this movement pushed us forward, even when the odds seemed insurmountable.

Your hard work, dedication, and generosity made this possible, proving that when we unite, we can achieve the impossible.
**Thank you for being a part of this historic movement.**
You’re not only challenging the status quo but also laying the foundation for a future where every voice matters.

Friends ,
This is the most important Congressional race in the nation, and here’s why:
Jim Jordan is a threat to our democracy and an embarrassment to Ohio.
But what’s truly telling is that he’s too extreme even for his own party, which is why he was blocked from becoming Speaker of the House.
It wasn’t just his Republican colleagues who feared his reckless, unethical behavior—farmers across Ohio banded together to prevent his rise to power.
Our food producers know that someone like Jordan, who prioritizes chaos over compromise, is a danger to our agriculture industry and our way of life.
As someone who grew up on an Ohio farm and has dedicated my life to advocating for the most vulnerable in our communities - I’m an entirely different kind of candidate. Let’s bring real community-backed leadership to Washington and show Jim Jordan the door. Join our movement today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240804_jordan_too_scary_link1]
Let me make something perfectly clear: in many ways, Jim Jordan is worse than Trump.
Trump may have set the stage for chaos, but Jim Jordan takes it a step further by using his position in Congress to actively dismantle democratic norms.
His track record of obstructing justice and using his office to legitimize baseless conspiracy theories reveals a calculated attempt to destabilize our government from within.
This is where I come in.
As someone who has seen firsthand the impact of Jordan’s harmful policies on our communities, I am committed to fighting for our families, farmers, and future.
I bring a lifetime of public service and advocacy to the table. My focus is on creating jobs, ensuring fair wages, and protecting our environment, so that every family can thrive.
Jim Jordan has failed to deliver on these issues for 17 years – a career in Congress in which he has authored and passed 0 bills!
We need leaders who listen and legislate with integrity, not those who sow division and fear. With your support, I can be that leader. Join us in this fight to restore ethics and accountability to our representation in Washington. Contribute today and help us win this race for the future of our community and our country. All the way back in 1870, Hiram Rhodes Revels, a pastor and State Senator from Mississippi, was elected as the first Black US Senator. Since then, we've come a long way as a country. **But representation – like our democracy – is a work in progress, and I believe we can do better.**

Black Americans have long faced _far too many_ obstacles like: discrimination, lower pay, higher job instability – not to mention the racist voter suppression laws that Texas Republicans like Ted Cruz have championed, which make it harder for certain folks to vote.

**The bottom line is this: It's essential that our government reflects the people it represents.**

I'm ready to defeat Ted Cruz this November and fight to build a more perfect union for my boys and every kid in Texas. But unlike Ted Cruz, I don't have corporate special interests footing the bill for my campaign.

**To win, I need a massive movement of grassroots supporters to step up and join me in this fight.** [Please, will you donate to me and the Voter Protection Project to power my campaign to defeat Ted Cruz, become the first Black Senator from Texas, and be the leader Texans deserve? →](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/73793?t=9&akid=15907%2E878179%2EzCQOY8)

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
IL GOP Preaches Unity While Former GOP Gov. Jim Edgar Praises Pritzker, Says he’s Voting for Kamala Harris (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/il-gop-preaches-unity-while-former-gop-gov-jim-edgar-praises-pritzker-says-hes-voting-for-kamala-harris.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e26ace9e3f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/il-gop-preaches-unity-while-former-gop-gov-jim-edgar-praises-pritzker-says-hes-voting-for-kamala-harris.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e26ace9e3f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Former IL Gov. Jim Edgar endorses State Rep. Dan Brady, R-Bloomington for Secretary of State. (Dave Dahl/WJBC)
By Illinois Review

Earlier this week, former Illinois Republican Gov. Jim Edgar – who remains a deeply respected politician among IL GOP circles, announced on WMAY radio in Springfield that he was voting for Kamala Harris – calling former President Donald Trump the “worst thing that’s happened” for politics in America.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/il-gop-preaches-unity-while-former-gop-gov-jim-edgar-praises-pritzker-says-hes-voting-for-kamala-harris.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e26ace9e3f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
“I won’t vote for Trump. I’ve never voted for Trump. He’s the worst thing that’s ever happened to American government and politics,” Edgar told Springfield Morning News. When pressed by the host if he’d be voting for Harris, he said, “I will.”

Edgar did not vote for Trump in 2016 or 2020. In 2018, after he was elected governor, JB Pritzker appointed Edgar to serve on his
transition team (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2018/11/07/gov-elect-jb-pritzker-names-transition-team-including-former-gop-gov-jim-edgar-michael-sacks/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e26ace9e3f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) as the billionaire businessman prepared to assume office several months later. Edgar appeared to be the only Republican to serve in that capacity.

>From 1991-1999, Edgar served as the 48th governor of Illinois. Prior to his election as governor, Edgar served as Illinois Secretary of State from 1981-1991. And for two years, he served as a member of the Illinois House of Representatives.
The former GOP governor remains a big fan of Gov. Pritzker. During a media interview in 2022 (https://chicago.suntimes.com/columnists/2022/2/19/22942056/illinois-governor-primary-election-jim-edgar-jb-pritzker-candidates-republican-gop?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e26ace9e3f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , he said he thought Pritzker did “a pretty good job” during the pandemic, saying, “There will be people mad about the way he handled the pandemic. I think he did a pretty good job.”

body:
Illegal immigrants are infiltrating US elections

|
---
Friend,

It’s no secret that the Biden-Harris Administration has allowed more illegal immigrants into our nation than any other presidency. **There have been over 15 million KNOWN illegal immigrants who have entered America since 2021,** and _there’s no way to monitor them once they cross our borders._

There is no regulation for illegal immigrants in Biden and Harris’s America.

**This reality results in increased crime rates, governmental benefits being granted to non-citizens while Americans struggle to make ends meet, and—worst of all—illegals who slip under the radar and vote in American elections.**
_We cannot jeopardize the integrity of our federal elections._ It is already illegal for non-citizens to vote in America, but the Biden-Harris Administration is doing nothing to safeguard our elections because they think they can use illegal votes for Democratic gain.

**It has been reported that when illegals sign up for government benefits, they are prompted to register to vote.**
This must be stopped. House Republicans are introducing the **Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act or the SAVE Act** as a solution. If this bill is passed, individuals must present a government-issued ID at the time of voter registration. The SAVE Act would ensure the integrity of our federal elections. It would protect the existing federal law that mandates American citizenship to vote in American elections. It would be a safeguard for our system against the millions of undocumented immigrants in our nation.

clean_body: Illegal immigrants are infiltrating US elections | Friend, It’s no secret that the Biden-Harris Administration has allowed more illegal immigrants into our nation than any other presidency. There have been over 15 million KNOWN illegal immigrants who have entered America since 2021, and there’s no way to monitor them once they cross our borders. There is no regulation for illegal immigrants in Biden and Harris’s America. This reality results in increased crime rates, governmental benefits being granted to non-citizens while Americans struggle to make ends meet, and—worst of all—illegals who slip under the radar and vote in American elections. We cannot jeopardize the integrity of our federal elections. It is already illegal for non-citizens to vote in America, but the Biden-Harris Administration is doing nothing to safeguard our elections because they think they can use illegal votes for Democratic gain. It has been reported that when illegals sign up for government benefits, they are prompted to register to vote. This must be stopped. House Republicans are introducing the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act or the SAVE Act as a solution. If this bill is passed, individuals must present a government-issued ID at the time of voter registration. The SAVE Act would ensure the integrity of our federal elections. It would protect the existing federal law that mandates American citizenship to vote in American elections. It would be a safeguard for our system against the millions of undocumented immigrants in our nation. | It is vital to secure our elections before November. We cannot allow anything to compromise our democracy. name: LinebergerforUSCongress
subject: Update from Lineberger for US Congress – August 4th, 2024
body:
Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

*Get Engaged*. *Stay engaged*. We are down to within the last 93 days
until the election is complete.
October 7th is the last day to register and be able to vote in this
election.
October 21 marks the start of early voting. November 5th is election day!
What we do now will make all of the difference in the quality of our lives
post-election.

With that in mind, here is what’s coming up soon.

Saturday, August 10th, Block Walking, 9 AM to Noon, Flower Mound, Precinct
3139
Meeting at Walmart Neighborhood Market, 2800 Flower Mound Rd,
Flower Mound, TX 75022
Link to RSVP and details:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/655760/

Sunday, August 11th, Morning, We’ll visit and worship at another Church in
the District
We get to know more about communities in our district, and
often share our campaign story with a few people

Sunday, August 11th, 1:30 PM – 2:30 PM, Meeting with Sanger Dem’s at the
Starbucks in Sanger

Tuesday, August 13th, 6 PM – 8 PM, Wise County Candidate Meet & Greet,
Decatur Fairfield Inn

Saturday, August 17th, Block Walking, 9 AM to Noon, Flower Mound, Precinct
3149
Meeting at Café inside Market Street, 3800 Long Prairie Rd
Link to RSVP and details:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/660686/

Monday, August 19 – 22, Democratic National Convention, Chicago

Wednesday, August 21st, Flower Mound Area Democrats General Meeting

Thursday, August 22nd, NAIFA Legislative Reception, Addison, TX

Saturday, August 24th, Block Walking, 9 AM to Noon, Location TBD

Saturday, August 24th, LBJ Obama Dinner, DCDP, Hilton Garden Inn, Lewisville

Saturday, August 31st, Block Walking, 9 AM to Noon, Location TBD

In addition to these events, we will be continuing our phone banking,
postcards, and other efforts to reach out to voters. Contact us to get
involved.

YARD SIGNS: We made a special purchase of 500 yard signs due to arrive very
soon.
August 7th is the date that signs can go up in public
places. We’ll need some help getting some in good visible places. Most of
these will be going to homes. Signs at homes (when visible) have a
positive impact on the neighborhood. It sends the message of comradery and
numbers.

Digital Advertising: We signed a contract to stream ads to targeted voters’
phones in a program to leave over one million impressions. Next, I’ll be
working to create the videos to be used in those ads. This costs money,
but is a good force multiplier when done in concert with our more personal
but time-consuming methods. It is much less expensive than TV advertising.

Some highlights from this last week include,
Thursday, August 1st, Attended the Coppell Rotary Club, saw
some friends, made new friends, heard a very interesting and promising
presentation about Project Unity which began here in Dallas and has special
events “Together we Ball’, “Together we Learn’, and “Together we dine” each
with their unique angel at smoothing social differences and building better
communities. Powerful.

Friday, August 2nd, Attended Flower Mound Dem’s get together
at Guitars and Growlers, caught up with some friends and made a few new
friends. Good food and lots of good ideas to keep campaign 2024 moving
forward.
Saturday, August 3rd, had a very successful block Walk event
in Castle Hills, Lewisville, TX. We had 10 walkers and knocked about 370
doors.
That Saturday evening, visited the Sanger Moonlight Madness
Farmers Market in Sanger Square. It was quite the family event with lots
of food and fun.

Sunday, August 4th, Enjoyed a special 25th anniversary
worship service at Grace Avenue United Methodist Church, Frisco, TX.
Shared an inspiring service and visited with a few folks before and after
the service.

To donate, just go to the regular donation link on the campaign website,
https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/.

Everything you do to support us in our efforts to get our message out,
support our campaign financially, and your own personal efforts to share
our message are making a difference. Thank you!

Giving Voters a Better Choice and Hope for a Better Future!

Ernest Lineberger

Your Democratic Nominee for US House for TX CD26.

Good food and lots of good ideas to keep campaign 2024 moving forward. Saturday, August 3rd, had a very successful block Walk event in Castle Hills, Lewisville, TX. We had 10 walkers and knocked about 370 doors. That Saturday evening, visited the Sanger Moonlight Madness Farmers Market in Sanger Square. It was quite the family event with lots of food and fun. Sunday, August 4th, Enjoyed a special 25th anniversary worship service at Grace Avenue United Methodist Church, Frisco, TX. Shared an inspiring service and visited with a few folks before and after the service. To donate, just go to the regular donation link on the campaign website, . Everything you do to support us in our efforts to get our message out, support our campaign financially, and your own personal efforts to share our message are making a difference. Thank you! Giving Voters a Better Choice and Hope for a Better Future! Ernest Lineberger Your Democratic Nominee for US House for TX CD26.
